cues.en: -: If you take a statistics course with a math professor, your professor will probably tell you that you shouldn't waste your time memorizing formulas.
cues.zh: 如果向數學教授修統計課，教授大概會告訴你，不要浪費時間背公式。

cues.en: And instead, you should focus on understanding the concepts behind the formulas so that you can always reconstruct the formulas or re derive them when you need to.
cues.zh: 應該專注理解公式背後的概念，這樣需要時，隨時都能重建公式，或重新推導。

cues.en: Now, that sounds like good advice, and I'm sure people who say things like that mean well.
cues.zh: 這聽起來是好建議，我相信說這些話的人出發點是好的。

cues.en: But the fact is that it's very easy for someone who's been studying and teaching statistics and math for decades to say something like that because they are so familiar with those formulas
cues.zh: 但事實是，對研究、教授統計與數學幾十年的人來說，很容易這麼說，因為他們對公式太熟悉，

cues.en: that it's almost trivial for them to re derive the formula from scratch.
cues.zh: 從頭重新推導，幾乎是輕而易舉的事。

cues.en: But that is totally different from struggling to learn the formulas for the very first time in your first statistics course.
cues.zh: 但這和第一次上統計課，努力初學公式，完全不同。

cues.en: So what do I think?
cues.zh: 那我的看法呢？

cues.en: Do I think you should memorize formulas?
cues.zh: 我認為應該背公式嗎？

cues.en: Actually, yes, I do.
cues.zh: 其實，是的。

cues.en: Of course not every single formula needs to be completely committed to memory, but I think it's actually a good idea to try to memorize
cues.zh: 當然不是每個公式都必須完整記住，但我認為，試著記住，

cues.en: some of the most important formulas in statistics.
cues.zh: 統計中一些最重要的公式，是好主意。

cues.en: And that's because when you memorize a formula, it becomes easier to understand and remember the concept that that formula is expressing.
cues.zh: 因為記住公式後，就更容易理解並記住公式表達的概念。

cues.en: Now, in other cases, I don't think you need to memorize the entire formula per se, but I do think it's worth memorizing the concept
cues.zh: 其他情況下，我不認為需要背下整個公式，但值得記住概念，

cues.en: or the idea, or just some of the key bits of the formula.
cues.zh: 或想法，或公式中一些關鍵部分。

cues.en: So as I go through this course and each time I introduce a formula, I will tell you whether you need to memorize that formula or not.
cues.zh: 所以在課程中，每次介紹公式，我都會告訴你需不需要記住。

cues.en: Now, some formulas you don't need to memorize because they're worked into analysis software that you actually use in practice to do your statistics.
cues.zh: 有些公式不必背，因為已經內建在實際做統計分析所使用的軟體中。

cues.en: In those cases, I show you the formulas to make sure you get the concept and to prevent the case where you might think that the analyses are magical
cues.zh: 那種情況下，我展示公式，是為了讓你理解概念，避免以為這些分析是魔法，

cues.en: or just really, really complicated.
cues.zh: 或真的非常非常複雜。

cues.en: And of course, all the formulas for statistics can be found online or in textbooks in case you ever need to look them up.
cues.zh: 而且，所有統計公式都能在網路或教科書找到，需要時隨時能查。

cues.en: But there are formulas that I really think are worth committing to memory and I will try to remember every time I introduce such a formula
cues.zh: 但有些公式，我真的認為值得記在腦中。每次介紹這類公式時，我會盡量記得，

cues.en: to tell you which formulas should be memorized or sometimes, yeah, just memorized a little bit so the key aspects of the formula should be memorized,
cues.zh: 告訴你哪些應該背，或有時只需稍微記一下，也就是記住關鍵部分，

cues.en: maybe not necessarily the entire formula, including all of the optional parameters.
cues.zh: 不一定要記住包含所有選用參數的整個公式。

cues.en: I think that memorizing important formulas will help you understand how the analysis works.
cues.zh: 我認為，記住重要公式，能幫助你理解分析如何運作。

cues.en: One example is the T test.
cues.zh: 一個例子是 t 檢定。

cues.en: I think that if you memorize the formula for the T statistic, then that will help you remember exactly what a T-test tests for.
cues.zh: 如果記住 t 統計量的公式，會幫助你記住 t 檢定究竟在檢驗什麼。

cues.en: And I think that memorizing the formula for the T statistic will help you connect the T-test to other kinds of statistical analyses
cues.zh: 我也認為，記住 t 統計量公式，會幫助你把 t 檢定與其他統計分析連結起來，

cues.en: that have a similar overall structure, but are slightly different.
cues.zh: 那些分析整體結構相似，但稍有不同。
